lookback_summary: Well, what a mixed bag we had this weekend! The model really nailed the Fulham vs Man United clash, correctly predicting a draw, while it also called the home win for Man City against Sunderland—who could have seen that 5-3 thriller coming? On the flip side, I had to eat humble pie with the Leeds vs Crystal Palace fixture, where the model went for a home win but was left scratching its head over a dull draw. And let’s not forget the shocker at Brighton, where the model predicted an away result but Arsenal turned up to demolish the Seagulls instead! Overall, some hits and misses, but that’s the Premier League for you—unpredictable to the last whistle!
